newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bongrain buys third Hungarian cheese firm.
newsitem.headline: Bongrain buys third Hungarian cheese firm.

text.p: French agri-food group Bongrain said on Monday it had acquired control of a cheese company in Hungary, Zalatej, which produces 4,000 tonnes of dairy products annually.
Bongrain did not disclose the terms, but said in a statement that Zalatej, in western Hungary, generated around 130 million francs in annual sales from cheese products.

It said it had raised its stake in Zalatej to 60 percent by subscribing to a capital increase. "Already present in Hungary with Veszpremtej and Repcelaki, Bongrain extends its range in a country with a strong cheese and dairy tradition," it said.
